title: Entity timeline
description: What this platform has already stored about one IP address, host or user: incident records and bounded top-contributor lists. It is not a search of raw events and not a QRadar search.

form.label: Entity search
form.valueHint: An IP address, a host name or a user name.
form.tooLong: The value is longer than {max} characters, so no search was made. Shorten it and try again.
form.chooseKind: Choose what “{value}” is, then show the timeline again.

refused.title: The backend refused this search.
refused.generic: The value, kind or window could not be accepted as typed.

page.PARTIAL: Some lanes below are bounded, stale, switched off or not collected. An empty result in them does not prove the entity was absent.
page.NOT_COLLECTED: No lane measured this entity in this window, so nothing below is a finding about it.
page.TRUNCATED: This list is one page. More stored mentions match this window than are shown, newest first.

lanes.heading: What was checked
lanes.label: Entity timeline lanes
lanes.noneProven: Collection covered this window and the entity was not found.
lanes.notCounted: Not counted on a paged list.
lanes.forbiddenUnknown: Not shown: your role may not read this lane.
lanes.pagedNote: This list is a page, so the counts above are for this page only.

items.heading: Stored mentions
items.label: Stored mentions of the entity, newest first
items.severityTitle: Named severity, or a QRadar offense severity from 0 to 10

basis.TOP_N_TITLE: From a bounded top list: values below the cut were not stored.
basis.ADMITTED_TITLE: Tracked because it was admitted; other values were not stored.

empty.none: No stored mention of {value} in this window.
empty.caution: That is not a finding that it was absent. Read the status of each lane below: a lane that was not collected, or that stores only top contributors, cannot show absence.

dangling: {count, plural, one {# stored record} other {# stored records}} could no longer be opened and {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} not listed.

paging.label: Entity timeline pages
paging.shown: Showing {count, plural, one {# mention} other {# mentions}}, newest first.
